response.answer: The sources indicate that the input price for the claude-sonnet-4-5 API is $3 per million tokens (MTok) and the output price is $15 per MTok. The model is deprecated and will retire on November 30, 2026. It is recommended to migrate to the newer Claude Sonnet 5.5 model, which has an input price of $2 per MTok and an output price of $10 per MTok.
